# Qraftt

> Qraftt is a free browser-based static QR code generator at https://www.qraftt.com

Qraftt supports 30 QR types, live preview, design customization, local logo use, and PNG and SVG export. QR payloads and downloads are generated locally in the browser whenever possible. No signup, subscription, account, hosted redirect, scan-tracking backend, or file hosting is required. Downloaded static QR codes encode their destination or content directly and do not depend on Qraftt after download.

## Core pages

- [Qraftt home](https://www.qraftt.com/): Main browser-based QR generator.
- [All QR code generators](https://www.qraftt.com/qr-code-generator): Generator hub and supported formats.
- [About Qraftt](https://www.qraftt.com/about): Product scope, privacy, and static-generation principles.
- [Contact Qraftt](https://www.qraftt.com/contact): Support information.
